SELECT m.id, m.title, m.content, m.level, m.create_by, m.create_time, CASE WHEN r.id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS unread FROM message_notice m LEFT JOIN message_notice_read r ON r.message_id = m.id AND r.user_id = #{userId} WHERE m.enabled = 1 AND ( m.target_role IS NULL OR m.target_role = '' OR FIND_IN_SET(#{role}, REPLACE(m.target_role, ' ', '')) > 0 ) ORDER BY m.create_time DESC
LIMIT #{limit}
